messages.context: Alchemage：Not in a Faction；Alchemage：Starting the quest；Baar：Not in a Faction
messages.text: Hello there, adventurer!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你好啊,冒险者!

messages.context: Alchemage：Not in a Faction；Baar：Not in a Faction
messages.text: You look like someone who could help me with my research!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你看起来正是能帮我搞研究的人!

messages.context: Alchemage：Not in a Faction；Baar：Not in a Faction
messages.text: If you join our faction I might have some tasks for you.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 要是加入我们的阵营,我或许能给你安排些差事。

messages.context: Alchemage：Not in a Faction；Baar：Not in a Faction
messages.text: I'll make it worth your while.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 报酬绝不会让你失望。

messages.context: Alchemage：In the Barbarian Faction without the quest already started；Baar：In the Mage Faction without the quest already started
messages.text: You have no business talking to me.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你我之间没什么好谈的。

messages.context: Alchemage：Starting the quest；Baar：Starting the quest
messages.text: I'm the local alchemist, I do research on different types of gold.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我是这里的炼金术士,专门研究各种形态的黄金。

messages.context: Alchemage：Starting the quest；Baar：Starting the quest
messages.text: If you have some time maybe you could help me with some tasks.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 有空的话,也许你能帮我完成几项研究。

messages.context: Alchemage：Starting the quest；Baar：Starting the quest
messages.text: I'll make sure it's worth your time.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我保证不会让你白忙。

messages.context: Alchemage：Starting the quest；Baar：Starting the quest
messages.text: Talk to me again if you want to help out.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 愿意帮忙的话,再来找我聊聊。

messages.context: Alchemage：Needing  64 Gold Ingot；Baar：Needing  64 Gold Ingot
messages.text: To start out I'll need some generic gold to experiment on, could you get me a stack?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 先从普通黄金开始实验吧。能帮我弄一组金锭来吗?

messages.context: Alchemage：Needing  5 Golden Plate；Baar：Needing  5 Golden Plate
messages.text: Next I need some flat gold to test how reflective gold is, could you try forging gold into 5 gold plates?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 接下来我要测试黄金的反光性。能帮我锻造 5 块金板吗?

messages.context: Alchemage：Needing  1 Diver's Trunks；Baar：Needing  1 Diver's Trunks
messages.text: It seems like the first piece you brought me is only 25% of the magical power, could you get me the leggings?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 看来你带来的第一件装备只蕴含了整套魔力的 25%。能再把护腿找来吗?

messages.context: Alchemage：Needing  32 Enchanted Gold Block；Baar：Needing  32 Enchanted Gold Block
messages.text: Now I need a lot of compacted gold, it has to be extremely dense. A half stack should do.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 现在需要大量压实的黄金,密度越高越好。半组应该够了。

messages.context: Alchemage：Needing  5 Golden Powder；Baar：Needing  5 Golden Powder
messages.text: There is a fine-grained gold substance somewhere in the Hub, I'll need 5 of that.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 大厅某处有一种细颗粒的黄金物质,我需要 5 份。

messages.context: Alchemage：Needing  32 Enchanted Golden Carrot；Baar：Needing  32 Enchanted Golden Carrot
messages.text: Next I'm going to need a vegetable that is made out of solid gold. I want to experiment with how gold interacts with organics, maybe you could find some, like a half stack?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 接下来我要一种纯金做成的蔬菜,研究黄金与有机物的反应。你能找来半组左右吗?

messages.context: Alchemage：Needing  1 Golden Ball；Baar：Needing  1 Golden Ball
messages.text: I just need one last thing, there's an extremely dangerous scientist who sells an assortment of items, he has a special rounded type of gold. Try to convince him to sell you it.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 只差最后一样了。有个极其危险的科学家在卖各种东西,他手里有一种特殊的球状黄金。想办法说服他卖给你吧。

messages.context: Alchemage：Giving  1 Golden Ball；Baar：Giving  1 Golden Ball
messages.text: Finally, my research is complete!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 终于,我的研究完成了!

messages.context: Alchemage：Giving  1 Golden Ball；Baar：Giving  1 Golden Ball
messages.text: You have single-handedly sped up my research by several years.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你一个人就让我的研究进度提前了好几年。

messages.context: Alchemage：After completing the quest；Baar：After completing the quest
messages.text: If I ever need your help, I will be sure to let you know!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 以后再需要帮忙,我一定会来找你!

messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。

messages.context: Dean / Queen Nyx：During the  Mage Council meeting；Queen Nyx：During the  Mage Council meeting；Captain Ahone / Queen Nyx：During the  Mage Council meeting
messages.text: I see, we owe you adventurer, this object is of great value to us.

messages.zh: 原来如此。冒险者,我们欠你一份人情,这件东西对我们极其珍贵。

messages.context: Dean：During the  Mage Council meeting；Queen Nyx / Dean：During the  Mage Council meeting；Captain Ahone / Dean：During the  Mage Council meeting
messages.text: Yes indeed! With it we are able to extract salt from Netherrack, it will be a massive asset when cooking.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 确实如此! 有了它,我们就能从下界岩里提取盐,烹饪时可就派上大用场了。

messages.context: Dean：During the  Mage Council meeting；Queen Nyx / Dean：During the  Mage Council meeting；Captain Ahone / Dean：During the  Mage Council meeting
messages.text: You see, while we evolved past the need for crops and cattle, the quality of our food remains low.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你也知道,虽说我们早已不再依赖作物和牲畜,食物品质却一直不怎么样。

messages.context: Dean：During the  Mage Council meeting；Queen Nyx / Dean：During the  Mage Council meeting；Captain Ahone / Dean：During the  Mage Council meeting
messages.text: I would say close to 50% of our research is still spent on food artifacts and machines.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 可以说,我们近 50% 的研究仍花在食物器具和机器上。

messages.context: Dean / Captain Ahone：During the  Mage Council meeting；Queen Nyx / Captain Ahone：During the  Mage Council meeting；Captain Ahone：During the  Mage Council meeting
messages.text: And once again those Piglins stole our research.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 那些猪灵又一次偷走了我们的研究资料。

messages.context: Dean / Captain Ahone：During the  Mage Council meeting；Queen Nyx / Captain Ahone：During the  Mage Council meeting；Captain Ahone：During the  Mage Council meeting
messages.text: They believe we are working on war engines.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 他们认定我们在研制战争机器。

messages.context: Dean / Captain Ahone：During the  Mage Council meeting；Queen Nyx / Captain Ahone：During the  Mage Council meeting；Captain Ahone：During the  Mage Council meeting
messages.text: The tension is rising and soon we might have to cross swords with them.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 局势愈发紧张,我们恐怕很快就要与他们兵戎相见。

messages.context: Dean / Queen Nyx：During the  Mage Council meeting；Queen Nyx：During the  Mage Council meeting；Captain Ahone / Queen Nyx：During the  Mage Council meeting
messages.text: Captain Ahone, this isn't a conversation we should have right now.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: Ahone 队长,这些事现在不宜谈。

messages.context: Dean / Queen Nyx：During the  Mage Council meeting；Queen Nyx：During the  Mage Council meeting；Captain Ahone / Queen Nyx：During the  Mage Council meeting
messages.text: Thank you very much, %s. Would you mind leaving us now, we have matters to discuss.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 非常感谢你,%s。我们还有要事商议,能请你先回避一下吗?

messages.zh: %s,请回学院找我,我们有很多事要谈!
